disclaimer.lead: Health Trail is a notebook. It helps you keep track of someone's care: the calls, the visits, the questions, and the paperwork that piles up around all of it.
disclaimer.block.1.title: It is not a medical app
disclaimer.block.1.body: It gives no medical advice, and it is not a medical device. Nothing here replaces a doctor, a nurse, emergency services, or advice from a lawyer. If something is urgent, call emergency services.
disclaimer.block.2.title: It stays on this phone, and it stays yours
disclaimer.block.2.body: There is no account and no cloud. Your notes live on this device and go nowhere else unless you send them somewhere yourself. The app keeps them organized and never decides what any of it means.
disclaimer.block.3.title: Free, and nothing is tracked
disclaimer.block.3.body: There are no ads, no subscription, and nothing to unlock. Nothing you do here is tracked or measured.

about.title: About Health Trail
about.lead: A notebook for the person keeping track of somebody else's care.
about.privacy.body: Everything you write stays on this phone. There is no account, no cloud, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you send it yourself.
about.support.body: Built and carried by one person. The app is free, has nothing to buy, and tracks nothing. Either way, it is yours.
about.licenses.body: The code is AGPL-3.0. The template content is CC BY-SA 4.0, published separately so it is useful with a paper binder or a spreadsheet, by people who never install anything. The bundled typefaces carry their own licenses.

export.lead: One file with everything in it: every entry, every person, every photograph, and everything you have deleted, so a restore puts things back exactly as they are.

archive.page.howto.body: Every entry shows the id it has in {database}, so anything here can be matched to the machine copy by hand. Photographs and documents are in the {attachments} folder beside this one, and the links here point straight at them. Nothing on these pages needs an internet connection.

restore.how.group: What should happen to what is here
restore.how.replace.label: Replace what is here
restore.how.replace.detail: Your notebook becomes exactly what is in the file. Anything written since the file was made is gone.
restore.how.merge.label: Keep both
restore.how.merge.detail: Everything in the file is added to what is here. Where the same thing was written in both, the one written later is kept and you can read what the other one said.
restore.warning.merge: Nothing here is removed. Where the same thing was written in both, the one written later is kept, and both versions are saved so you can see what changed.
restore.done.merge: Done. Both notebooks are here now.
restore.refused: Nothing was merged. This file has records that point at something neither notebook has, so putting them in would leave part of the record with no home. Nothing here was changed.
conflicts.title: What the merge decided
conflicts.lead: When the same thing was written on two phones, the one written later was kept. Nothing was thrown away, so here is what the other one said.
conflicts.empty.detail: Nothing has been merged yet, or nothing was written in two places at once. If it ever is, it will be here.
conflicts.kept.local: The one on this phone was kept
conflicts.kept.incoming: The one in the file was kept
conflicts.reason.same_time: because both were written at the same moment, so the phone that made it decided
conflicts.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing merged yet} one {1 to look at} other {# to look at}}
